name: Cellular Base-Station Aggregation Nodes
description: Many cellular/base-station registries -> one deconflicted SDS $TBS site stream. Three pure flow nodes: `route` turns one $HTQ request into N hostcap/http-request GET descriptors for the provider set the CALLER named plus the run contract; `parse` decodes each provider's native payload into normalized reports; `deconflict` merges reports across providers under the caller's chosen tbsMergeMethod and emits a size-prefixed $TBS record stream plus a run summary. Configuration is REQUEST-SCOPED, never node-global, so two callers can ask for different provider sets at once without either changing what the node is. No capabilities: this node performs no I/O — http is the generic hostcap connector node. Providers requiring a login are skipped with an explicit reason until the node can store a credential.

sequentialJustification.detail: All three methods are single-pass transforms over frames the flow hands them: `route` formats fetch descriptors from the request, `parse` walks each provider body once, and `deconflict` groups reports and emits one record per group. There is no shared mutable state, no worker pool and no fan-out inside the guest — the fan-out is the flow's, across N http connector nodes. This guest can never spawn a thread, so it compiles clang/wasi-sequential rather than claiming a wasi-threads contract it does not honour.

methods.description: Reads the caller's PROVIDERS list, METHOD and LIMIT from one $HTQ request and emits one hostcap/http-request descriptor per selected provider plus the run contract. An unknown METHOD is REFUSED on the reply port rather than silently defaulted. Providers requiring a login are skipped with an explicit reason.

methods.description: Answers the provider list this node can actually reach: each provider's access posture, licence, attribution, whether a credential is currently held, and the merge methods on offer. Reports NO credential values and no key material. The configuring page renders exactly this and compiles no provider list of its own.

wildcardJustification.detail: Normalized intermediate produced and consumed inside this flow. It is deliberately NOT $TBS: a single provider's unreconciled report cannot satisfy the standard's required CONSENSUS, and emitting one would assert a deconfliction that has not happened.

methods.description: Groups reports across providers by network identity (falling back to proximity where a provider publishes no identifiers) and merges each group under the caller's tbsMergeMethod, emitting one $TBS record per site with every contributing provider in SOURCES and the merge recorded in CONSENSUS. Semantics mirror packages/cell-towers-worldwide/src/deconflict.mjs and are parity-gated against it.
